limitations: These files are source fragments and associated API responses, not a complete corresponding native-source or toolchain closure.

Observed-checkout groups are bound to the preserved upstream job logs. The MXE group identifies the current source tag of the release URL downloaded by the Windows packaging job; its original producer job and original ZIP response were not recovered.

Git source bytes are checked against their recorded Git blob IDs. External fixed-revision patches are the response bytes acquired on retrievedOn; their historical download response bytes were not archived.
Floating URLs and unresolved Cargo workspace/vendor inputs remain unavailable. Recipe version strings and log URLs do not prove possession of dependency archives or compiler binaries.
Original file notices and available repository license files are retained. The fragments do not establish all constituent licensing or any license-compatibility conclusion.
No compilation, binary replacement, identical historical binary output, historical toolchain replay, or release acceptance is established by this acquisition.
